owner_confirmation_needed.item: Confirm current prices, availability and offer validity.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: Cordura Bag and Pullover Navy had conflicting prices in the source. S-GARD Command Fleecejacke is listed from 59.25 EUR and at 71.25 EUR in different source sections; all affected listings now ask for the price.

owner_confirmation_needed.item: Confirm course ages, prerequisites, fees and teaching formats.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: The source gives 8 years for Open Water Diver and 13 for e-learning. These are source claims, not independently verified certification standards.

owner_confirmation_needed.item: Supply future course and trip dates.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: Imported past schedules are visibly archived. The site asks visitors to enquire about the next date.

owner_confirmation_needed.item: Review legal text against the actual new site and hosting.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: The imported text still mentions registration/accounts, measurement/marketing and older external legal references. This site has no accounts, checkout, tracking or map embeds.

owner_confirmation_needed.item: Confirm preferred email, contact hours and any active recruitment.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: dive-world@mail.de is the consistent primary contact. The second original address remains on the contact and legal pages. The recruitment page asks about the relevant season.

owner_confirmation_needed.item: Choose the production URL and configure redirects, HTTPS and SEO metadata.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: SITE_URL enables canonical/share URLs. Product sharing uses its own image. The live DuckDNS preview is not updated by this local build.

owner_confirmation_needed.item: Provide higher-resolution original assets where available.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: The original logo and instructor portraits are retained. Some catalogue photos contain collage or brochure text. The old travel section supplied flags/logos rather than trip photographs, so it is now a factual trip archive. Real approved trip photos would improve it. One unavailable Monte Mare source photo was omitted.

owner_confirmation_needed.item: Confirm social profile URLs and whether payment instructions belong on the public site.
owner_confirmation_needed.details: The original about page listed social handles and bank/PayPal information. The redesign does not expose payment instructions in its enquiry journey. The original source is preserved in work/source-pages.

resolved_findings: Landing page omitted or buried several offers. It now exposes six visitor goals and four main areas.
Equipment categories and secondary services lacked clear explanations. The homepage and shop directory now connect them to their own pages.
Repeated products appeared multiple times in catalogue search. Matching names now share one search result while original listing pages remain accessible.
Conflicting S-GARD jacket prices were displayed as settled amounts. Both source variants now use a price enquiry with an explanation.
First-aid material fees could be mistaken for the whole course price. Learning materials and practical tuition are now distinguished.
Mandatory diving-course extras were hidden in expandable details. They are now visible before expanding.
The travel page displayed flags and venue logos as travel photographs. It is now a labelled chronological trip/event archive.
Archive pages had no useful next step. Achievement galleries now link back to the corresponding training.
Generic interior covers occupied excessive space. Their spacing and heading scale have been reduced.
Contact addresses varied between entry points. The primary address is now consistent, with the second original address retained on contact/legal pages.
Returning browsers could show stale shared assets. CSS and script URLs now include content hashes.
Homepage equipment previews used weak first-in-source images. Category previews now use selected original product photographs.
